# Low-risk path allowlist, read by .github/workflows/risk-guard.yml.
# A PR may carry `risk: low` only if EVERY changed file matches one of these globs.
# One glob per line. `*` stays within a directory, `**` crosses directories,
# a trailing `/` means "everything under this directory". Lines starting with # are ignored.
# Anything under .github/ is always rejected, whatever is listed here.
#
README.md
